$comment: Funder/partner dashboard nudges (dashboard/funder). Same format as src/lib/agentNudges/nudges.json: a nudge is eligible when every `when` rule holds AND every {placeholder} in its title/body has a value. Rules: gt, gte, lt, lte, eq, ne take numbers; exists takes true/false. `hour` is the Kampala hour (0-23), `day_of_week` is 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday), `day_of_month` is 1-31 (both Kampala). Money placeholders render with the viewer's currency already attached, so never write a currency before them. Only the signed-in Supporter's own numbers: never quote other Supporters or platform-wide totals. No tenant or agent data in any nudge: no names, no repayments, no amounts collected; the only house-related figures allowed are houses_supported (a count of homes held for the Supporter's own portfolios) and landlord_rent_paid (always null for now: no per-partner source exists). When the Supporter has no houses supported on file, houses_supported is 0 and that nudge is skipped. Facts about Welile must describe how the system actually works; add a dated, approved source before quoting any company-wide figure. Never pressure to invest ('missing out', 'act now'), never promise future Returns. Terminology: Rent Plan (never loan), Supporter (never lender/investor in copy), Returns (never interest/ROI). Stats contract (to be returned by get_funder_nudge_stats): first_name, active_portfolios, total_principal, next_payout_date, days_to_next_payout, returns_last_amount, hours_since_last_returns, total_returns_received, returns_milestone_reached (1 when total Returns crossed a round milestone in the last 7 days), portfolio_label, maturity_date, days_to_maturity (soonest-maturing portfolio), is_compounding, growth_portfolio_label, start_amount, current_value, growth_amount, houses_supported, landlord_rent_paid, returns_this_month, days_as_supporter, years_as_supporter, years_as_supporter_label ('1 year' / '2 years'), is_anniversary_today, wallet_balance, wallet_idle_days, referrals_30d. Money keys: total_principal, returns_last_amount, total_returns_received, returns_this_month, start_amount, current_value, growth_amount, landlord_rent_paid, wallet_balance. Date keys (rendered like '7 Nov'): next_payout_date, maturity_date. Sources and isolation rules: see supabase/migrations/20261021200000_funder_nudge_stats.sql.

nudges.title: Good morning {first_name} ☀️
nudges.body: You have {active_portfolios} active portfolios worth {total_principal}, all working for you today.

nudges.title: Returns on the way 📅
nudges.body: Your next Returns are scheduled for {next_payout_date}, {first_name}.

nudges.title: Payday 💸
nudges.body: {returns_last_amount} just landed in your wallet, {first_name}. Enjoy it!

nudges.title: Milestone unlocked 🎉
nudges.body: You've now received {total_returns_received} in Returns since you joined Welile. Thank you for backing tenants, {first_name}.

nudges.title: {days_to_maturity} days to maturity ⏳
nudges.body: Your portfolio {portfolio_label} matures on {maturity_date}. Your final Returns payout comes first, then you can renew.

nudges.title: Your money is growing 🌱
nudges.body: {growth_portfolio_label} has grown from {start_amount} to {current_value} by keeping its Returns growing.

nudges.title: Homes backed by you 🏠❤️
nudges.body: Right now your portfolios are backing {houses_supported} homes. Thank you, {first_name}.

nudges.title: Rent paid, homes kept 🔑
nudges.body: Through Welile, your portfolios have paid {landlord_rent_paid} in rent straight to landlords.

nudges.title: {returns_this_month} in Returns this month 📈
nudges.body: That's what your portfolios have paid you so far this month, {first_name}.

nudges.title: Did you know? 🤔
nudges.body: Every Rent Plan starts repaying the day after it's funded. Tenants pay in small daily amounts, not one big monthly bill.

nudges.title: Did you know? 💡
nudges.body: Welile pays rent directly to the landlord, so your money goes into a real home, not into a tenant's pocket.

nudges.title: Welcome to Welile, {first_name} 👋
nudges.body: Your portfolio is set up. We'll let you know each time Returns land in your wallet.

nudges.title: Happy Welile anniversary 🥳
nudges.body: {years_as_supporter_label} as a Supporter today, {first_name}. Thank you for backing tenants.

nudges.title: {wallet_balance} is sitting in your wallet 👛
nudges.body: Withdraw it, or put it into a portfolio whenever you're ready. No rush.

nudges.title: Know someone who'd back tenants? 🤝
nudges.body: Share your Welile link and help more families get a Rent Plan.
